source: Explore the scenic Thames Valley with Thames Branches, featuring three classic offshoots of the Great Western Main Line. Travel to the regatta town of Henley-on-Thames, the royal destination of Windsor & Eton Central, and the charming riverside terminus at Marlow.
target: 通过泰晤士河谷支线探索风景如画的泰晤士河谷，体验大西部主线的三条经典分支。前往赛艇小镇泰晤士河畔亨利、皇家目的地温莎与伊顿中央，以及迷人的河畔终点站马洛。

source: Great Western Express brings to life the experience of driving high speed and commuter passenger trains on one of Britain’s busiest railways. Take control of the iconic Great Western Railways HST and command it to 125mph along the Great Western Main Line out of London's Paddington Main Line Station.
target: 大西部快线生动再现了在英国最繁忙的铁路上驾驶高速列车和通勤客车的体验。掌控标志性的Great Western Railway HST列车，使其在大西部主线上以125英里/小时的速度驶出伦敦帕丁顿火车总站。
